source.title: Thank people who share you in their story
source.original_goal: Thank people who share you in their story
source.demand_evidence: Catalogue presence only; popularity and conversion are unmeasured.

goal: Automatically thank people who mention the coach in their story.
blockers: Automatic story-mention acknowledgment is unverified: the actual mention trigger and automatic reply need native verification.

acknowledgment_policy.description: Approved thanks for a genuine story mention and handling of unrelated messages. No automatic trigger is verified.

messages.continuation: Automatic thanks for a story mention remains unverified. Asking the person to DM first or manually sending thanks does not verify automatic mention acknowledgment. Absence of a reaction operation does not prove that automatic text acknowledgment is impossible.
messages.refusal: Understood. I will not continue this campaign. You can ask our team for help.
messages.handoff: Our team will handle your request.

transitions.event: The coach requests automatic thanks for a story mention.
transitions.action: Report the unverified mention trigger and automatic reply; do not create a generic DM rule or require a reaction as the business goal.
transitions.evidence: Actual mention-triggered automatic acknowledgment has not been verified. A StoryMention message type alone is not automation evidence.

outcome: Automatic story-mention acknowledgment remains blocked pending actual trigger and reply verification.
negative_cases: Do not call a manually sent text or a DM-first invitation automatic story-mention acknowledgment.
No reaction operation does not prove that automatic text acknowledgment is impossible.

resume.action: Recheck native mention-trigger and automatic-reply evidence before proposing any preparation. This recipe remains blocked without it.
resume.campaign_match: Require an actual story mention linked to the same account, recipient and automatic reply; do not infer a working trigger from a message type.

stop.action: No automation is created; there is nothing to disable.
stop.proof: Honest rejection is tested, not a released funnel.

unverified_story_acknowledgment_declined.description: The assistant reports automatic mention acknowledgment as unverified, preserves the thanks goal and does not claim a text alternative impossible from missing reaction support alone.
